- Whether it has an entry in guardrails/gate-red-proofs.json (search by gate letter or script name)

# gate shape (fresh review record / green tests / ownership / coverage) travels as-is.

# before any gate below can touch stdin — a manual invocation for testing leaves stdin as a tty and
# must never block on a read. A push whose every fed line deletes its remote counterpart (the
# all-zero local object id) carries no content for any gate to judge, so the whole chain stands down
# by name instead of falling to the reach map's conservative FULL — the fix for the 2026-07-27 hang
# (four tag deletions read as an empty diff, fell to the full suite, died on the two-minute limit).
# This check carries no gate letter: it is a triage read ahead of the chain, the placement
# check-push-reach.sh already holds inside gate b, not a net that blocks on red.
#
# The marker below is the machine-readable half of the convention guardrails/check-prover-record.sh
# states in full: every arm that can let a push past the prover-record demand carries one
# `# STAND-DOWN: <name>` line, and PRODUCT_SPEC.md R226 criterion 6 must name that same <name>.
# tests/test_deletion_only_push.py reads both directions off these markers.
# STAND-DOWN: deletion-only
if [ -t 0 ]; then
  PUSH_REF_LINES=""
else
  PUSH_REF_LINES="$(cat)"

  set +e
  del_out="$("$GUARDRAILS/check-deletion-only-push.sh")"

    exit 0

# gates.yml — the CI mirror of the push gate (SPEC M-5, ROADMAP row 14).
# Same checks, one source of truth: CI runs the SAME scripts the local pre-push hook
# runs — it never redefines them. This is the SECOND net: the local reach map
# (SPEC INV-45) is a developer-latency optimization; the CI net always runs the full set.
name: gates
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  gates:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      TZ: Asia/Jerusalem   # gate (a) wants a today-dated prover record; "today" is the author's day, not UTC's
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0    # gate (a)'s freshness rule reads commit history (record vs PRODUCT_SPEC.md)
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: install pytest
        run: pip install pytest
      # The external canon, pinned. Before this step existed the suite ran with no clone,
      # so every assertion that reads the externalized product-prover skipped on every CI
      # run forever, and CI claimed a green it had not earned (ROADMAP row 622 territory;
      # the same fork the emergency branch reached from the other side). The pack now
      # INSTALLS the canon rather than pretending to prove it: --ref names the exact commit
      # the pack's assertions are written against, and --expect-commit verifies the checkout
      # landed there, so a moved tag or branch cannot change what CI proves. Moving the pin
      # is a deliberate pack change; tests/test_prover_adapter_contract.py holds its shape.
      - name: install the external product-prover canon (pinned, gate b's evidence)
        run: >-
          scripts/install-external-skills.sh
          --ref 94d36454d55438951311d302fc86adba33123868
          --expect-commit 94d36454d55438951311d302fc86adba33123868
      - name: test suite (gate b, full — the reach map stays local)
        run: python3 -m pytest -q
      - name: gate a — fresh prover record (one record per push, SPEC M-6/INV-116/INV-304)
        # LIVE_SPEC_DIFF_BASE lets the script judge the inbox-only carve-out (row 269,
        # SPEC M-6/INV-112): a push whose diff is exactly one new inbox/ file owes no
        # fresh record. The same base carries the range arm, which reads the pushed delta
        # against the state the remote already holds. github.event.before is the pre-push
        # SHA on a push; on a PR it is empty and the script falls back to origin/main,
        # which the fetch-depth-0 checkout above carries.
        env:
          LIVE_SPEC_DIFF_BASE: ${{ github.event.before }}
        run: guardrails/check-prover-record.sh --push
      - name: gate d — matrix Reference generated and agrees with the body
        run: python3 guardrails/check-matrix-reference.py TEST_MATRIX.md
      - name: gate g — pin drift
        run: guardrails/check-pin-drift.sh
      - name: gate f — skill loadability
        run: guardrails/check-skill-loadability.sh
      - name: gate e — prototype fence
        run: guardrails/check-prototype-fence.sh
      - name: gate i — shipped language (no owner name / stray Cyrillic in the shipped set, SPEC INV-120)
        run: guardrails/check-shipped-language.sh
      - name: gate j — no broad browser-kill (cleanup targets the test resource only, SPEC INV-162)
        run: guardrails/check-broad-kill.sh
      - name: gate l — muted browser launch (every browser-driving script launches muted, SPEC INV-157)
        run: guardrails/check-muted-launch.sh
      - name: gate o — cleanup notice (every cleanup path that ends a process says what it ended, SPEC INV-204)
        run: guardrails/check-cleanup-notice.sh
      - name: gate p — touchpoint kind (a surface speaks only the kind its touchpoint affords, SPEC INV-205)
        run: python3 guardrails/check-touchpoint-kind.py
      - name: gate q — waiting list (the board loses nothing — no over-cap shown set, no demotion into the void, SPEC INV-206)
        run: python3 guardrails/check-board.py
      - name: gate r — authority anchor (a decision recorded as the person's names its exchange, SPEC INV-207)
        run: python3 guardrails/check-authority-anchor.py
      - name: gate s — skill review (a substantive skill change carries its skill-creator review record, SPEC INV-208)
        # LIVE_SPEC_DIFF_BASE lets the gate read the push range (the same base as gate a); on a PR it
        # is empty and the gate falls back to origin/main.
        env:
          LIVE_SPEC_DIFF_BASE: ${{ github.event.before }}
        run: guardrails/check-skill-review.sh
      - name: gate t — doc rotation (the pack's split-and-rotated docs lose nothing, SPEC INV-209)
        run: python3 guardrails/check-doc-rotation.py
      - name: gate h — the four host checks (this repo attached as its own first host, SPEC INV-97)
        # The base ladder mirrors gate a: github.event.before on a push, else a fetched origin/main,
        # else HEAD~1 — so the host checks compare against a ref that exists on any CI checkout.
        run: |
          base="${{ github.event.before }}"
          if [ -z "$base" ] || ! git cat-file -e "${base}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
            git fetch -q origin main 2>/dev/null || true
            base="origin/main"
          fi
          if ! git cat-file -e "${base}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then base="HEAD~1"; fi
          for c in completeness tests_present traces_to_spec conflicts; do
            python3 scaffold/guardrails/check_${c}.py --base "$base"
          done
      - name: gate n — the earned message (an agent's inbox deposit names its birth, SPEC INV-189)
        run: |
          # Report-only (the owner's word, 2026-08-07 11:19): a deposit never blocks a push;
          # the intake sweep is the judging moment.
          if [ -d inbox ]; then
            python3 guardrails/check-earned-message.py inbox || \
              echo "deposits above await the intake sweep; a deposit never blocks a push"
          else
            echo "no inbox in this checkout — the gate stands down by name"
          fi
      # The named-reference presence nets (SPEC INV-239) take NO push-gate letter: they RIDE THE SUITE
      # (the pytest step, gate b), the same placement the far-tier report-shape check takes, so they
      # need no separate CI step here and no ci-mirror carve-out — a suite-riding check carries no gate
      # letter for the mirror to track.
      - name: gate u — CI mirror parity (every local gate is mirrored in CI or a declared carve-out, SPEC INV-210)
        run: guardrails/check-ci-mirror.sh
      - name: gate w — every gate can fail (every gate in this chain carries a known-red proof, SPEC INV-212)
        run: python3 guardrails/check-every-gate-can-fail.py
      - name: gate x — generated index (committed index equals a fresh build off the body; body and index agree; an empty body reds by name, SPEC INV-258/INV-259/INV-218)
        run: python3 guardrails/check-index-generated.py PRODUCT_SPEC.md PRODUCT_SPEC.index.md
      - name: gate y — agent card (a live-spec host tree carries its .live-spec/agent.md card, SPEC INV-219)
        run: python3 guardrails/check-agent-card.py
      - name: gate z — doc bound (each growable working doc within its declared bound or freshly rotated, SPEC INV-234)
        run: python3 guardrails/check-doc-bound.py
      - name: gate aa — doc findings bound (no live document above its recorded finding count, SPEC INV-301)
        # The record arm reads the record against the state the remote already holds (SPEC R302.12).
        # github.event.before is the pre-push SHA on a push; on a PR it is empty and the arm falls back
        # to origin/main, which the fetch-depth-0 checkout above carries.
        env:
          LIVE_SPEC_DIFF_BASE: ${{ github.event.before }}
        run: python3 guardrails/check-doc-findings-bound.py
      - name: gate ad — published tree counts (a count this repository publishes about its own tree is built from the tree, SPEC INV-305)
        run: python3 guardrails/check-tree-counts.py
      - name: gate ae — named checks (the registry says what each runnable file a skill body names is, SPEC INV-306)
        run: python3 guardrails/check-named-checks.py

  # After the gates pass on a real push to main, sync the standalone mirror repos from the
  # pack — the durable, cross-machine arm of the same job the local pre-push hook does (the
  # local hook covers this machine; CI covers any machine, including a browser/cloud session).
  # Auth is a per-mirror SSH deploy key held in the MIRROR_SYNC_DEPLOY_KEY secret. The job
  # skips cleanly when that secret is absent, so CI never reds for a missing key (honest
  # failure by name, SPEC INV-112). Extends the push gate (SPEC M-6) and scripts/sync-mirrors.sh
  # (SPEC INV-96).
  sync-mirrors:
    needs: gates
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false   # the mirror push authenticates with the deploy key below, not the default token
      - name: sync standalone mirrors from the pack
        env:
          MIRROR_SYNC_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.MIRROR_SYNC_DEPLOY_KEY }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "${MIRROR_SYNC_DEPLOY_KEY}" ]; then
            echo "MIRROR_SYNC_DEPLOY_KEY not set — skipping mirror sync (add the secret to enable the CI arm)."
            exit 0
          fi
          key_file="$(mktemp)"
          printf '%s\n' "${MIRROR_SYNC_DEPLOY_KEY}" > "$key_file"
          chmod 600 "$key_file"
          export GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -i $key_file -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o IdentitiesOnly=yes"
          export MIRROR_SSH=1   # tell sync-mirrors.sh to reach the mirror over SSH, not gh/HTTPS
          git config --global user.name "live-spec mirror bot"
          git config --global user.email "mirror-bot@users.noreply.github.com"
          bash scripts/sync-mirrors.sh
